hook: Your phone camera can bend a spinning fan.
title: Your Phone Camera Bends Spinning Fan Blades
description:
Film a spinning ceiling fan with any phone camera and the straight blades look curved. It happens because the camera reads the picture line by line, called rolling shutter. Takes ten seconds to try.

#Shorts #Tech #PhoneTricks
comment_prompt: Did your fan bend? Yes or no

scenes.narration: Your phone camera can bend a spinning fan.
scenes.headline: BENT FAN BLADES

scenes.narration: Switch on a ceiling fan at home.
scenes.headline: TURN ON A FAN

scenes.narration: Open your camera and film the blades.
scenes.headline: FILM THE BLADES

scenes.narration: On screen, the straight blades look curved.
scenes.headline: THEY LOOK CURVED

scenes.narration: Your camera reads the picture line by line.
scenes.headline: LINE BY LINE

scenes.narration: The blades move while it scans.
scenes.headline: BLADES KEEP MOVING

scenes.narration: That delay bends them on screen.
scenes.headline: ROLLING SHUTTER

scenes.narration: Try it now on any phone.
scenes.headline: TRY IT NOW

scenes.narration: Your phone really can bend a fan.
scenes.headline: IT'S REAL
